query: UPDATE mapping_reverify_state SET running = true, dry_run = $1, started_at = now(), heartbeat_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, checked = 0, failed = 0, removed = 0, unreachable = 0, failures = '[]'::jsonb, error = NULL WHERE id AND (NOT running OR heartbeat_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2)) RETURNING id
